label: An actual contingent concrete bearer rules out global forward guarded universal transfer (inference)
rule: Actualist domain correspondence and elimination of the contingent witness
meaning: The contingency premise gives one existing concrete bearer at the selected world and its absence at an accessible world. Apply boxAllToAllBox_iff to the same Ontic to obtain increasing domains from the proposed transfer. Apply increasing_excludes_contingency to that bearer at the selected world. The only open premise is the route's existing contingency node.
